name: NanoClaw
description: NanoClaw is an AI assistant that runs agents in isolated containers and connects them to messaging channels. This helper prepares a full Git checkout of upstream main for personal development, with Node.js, pnpm and the Docker agent runtime installed directly in an unprivileged Debian LXC.

notes.text: Fresh development installation only. The installer refuses an existing /opt/nanoclaw, /home/nanoclaw or nanoclaw account. It does not migrate older installations.

Complete setup from the Proxmox host: 'pct enter <CT_ID>', then 'machinectl shell nanoclaw@', then 'cd /opt/nanoclaw && bash nanoclaw.sh'. Use this login session so the upstream wizard can install and verify its systemd user service. Credentials, OneCLI, agent images and channels are configured by that wizard.

NanoClaw runs natively in the LXC. Its agents and OneCLI require Docker, with LXC nesting and keyctl enabled. The nanoclaw developer account belongs to the Docker group, which grants root-equivalent access inside the LXC. No account password is set by this helper.

Helper updates are disabled to protect local development work. Follow the checkout's .claude/skills/update-nanoclaw/SKILL.md for staged integration, backups, migrations and service recovery. Stop a manually running development host before updating.
